verdict.rationale: Orama ships a built-in conversational answer engine (AnswerSession, a ChatGPT-like experience over your data via Secure Proxy) and a JavaScript runtime for building agents. However, these are developer building blocks for question answering on your own site, not an assistant inside the product to which a user delegates tasks. The MCP server only exposes data to external AI tools. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant that executes delegated tasks (e.g., managing data sources or configuring search), any documented task-delegation or action-taking workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
